camel_example: aliyun eiam CreateClientPublicKey --region cn-hangzhou --AlgorithmType 'RSA-2048' --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --PublicKey 'example-string' --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --ClientToken 'client-token-example'
description_en: Creates a ClientPublicKey for an application. When an M2M client uses the PRIVATE_KEY_JWT method to request the token endpoint, this public key is used by the M2M authorization server to verify the assertion carried in the client's token endpoint request
description_zh: 创建应用ClientPublicKey（当M2M客户端使用PRIVATE_KEY_JWT方式请求token端点时，该公钥用于M2M授权服务器校验客户端请求token端点时，携带的assertion断言。）
kebab_example: aliyun eiam create-client-public-key --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --public-key example-string --algorithm-type RSA-2048 --client-token client-token-example --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateClientPublicKey

parameters.help_en: The public key in PEM format. The key must be of the SPKI type, starting with "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----" and ending with "-----END PUBLIC KEY-----"
parameters.help_zh: 公钥（PEM公钥格式：SPKI类型，以“-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----”开头，以“-----END PUBLIC KEY-----”结尾）
parameters.name: public_key

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate a parameter value, but make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see References: How to ensure idempotence (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《如何保证幂等性 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》
parameters.name: client_token

ClientPublicKeyId.description_en: The ID of the application ClientPublicKey
